TASK_GAP:
Requirement: "Print a plain line, for example `Editor attempt N: previous attempt was stall-killed; switching model to fallback <model>.`" — and, by extension, identify the stall kill as the cause whenever the fallback is engaged because of one.
Expected change site: `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh`, the editor attempt model-selection `if`/`elif` block at lines 2087-2096 (original final-attempt arm at 2087-2089, new stall-fallback arm at 2090-2095).
Evidence of absence: With default `editor_max_attempts=3`, when attempts 1 and 2 are stall-killed and attempt 3 begins, `editor_prev_attempt_stall_killed=1`, `editor_stall_fallback_active=0`, and `attempt == editor_max_attempts`, so the `if` arm at line 2087 fires first. The `elif` at line 2090 is skipped, and only `Final editor attempt: switching model to fallback ${EDITOR_ATTEMPT_MODEL} (primary ${MODEL_EDITOR} capacity-limited).` is printed at line 2089. The two new behavioural tests (`test_review_apply_fixes_stall_fallback_switch_behaviour` and `test_review_apply_fixes_stall_fallback_predicate_behaviour`) exercise helpers in isolation; `test_review_apply_fixes_final_attempt_condition_unchanged` pins only the unchanged final-attempt text. No case where stall-kill and final-attempt coincide is covered.
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
TASK_GAP:
Requirement: "Print a plain line, for example `Editor attempt N: previous attempt was stall-killed; switching model to fallback <model>.`"
Expected change site: `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh`, editor attempt model-selection branch (lines 2087-2096).
Evidence of absence: When attempt 2 ends with `stall_state=killed` (set in the `killed)` arm at line 2398) and attempt 3 is the final attempt, the `if` at line 2087 fires before the stall-fallback `elif` at line 2090. The fallback model is selected (line 2088) but only the "Final editor attempt: switching model to fallback ... (primary ... capacity-limited)" message is printed (line 2089); the stall-kill message at line 2092 never fires. The message is reachable only on a non-final switch (e.g. attempt 1 killed → attempt 2), the minority path given the 3-attempt loop and incident runs (35456293637, 35473950832). Minimal fix under 10 lines: inside the final-attempt `if` branch, print the stall-kill line when `editor_prev_attempt_stall_killed -eq 1` (and/or set `editor_stall_fallback_active=1`).
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
